name: plainly-guide
description: Find and compare creative AI tools in plain English: what each does, what it costs, open or closed, and whether you can sell what you make, with sources and check dates.

interface.longDescription: Plainly Guide helps you choose the right AI tool for creative work: making pictures, video, voiceovers, music, talking presenters and 3D models. Describe what you want to make and Plainly Guide returns a shortlist from its independent catalogue of 338 creative AI tools, models and services, with what each does, the free option, the cheapest paid plan, whether it is open or closed and whether you can sell what you make. You can also open one tool's full details or compare up to five side by side. Every fact links to the maker's own page and shows the date it was last checked. Plainly Guide does not create images or media itself; it helps you pick the tool. No sign-in, no personal data, and nobody pays to be listed or ranked.
defaultPrompt: What's a free tool to turn a photo into a short video?
Compare Suno and Udio for making songs I can sell.
Which open-source models can clone my voice for a podcast?

positive.description: Shortlist tools for a task with a free-only budget
positive.prompt: What's a free tool to turn a photo into a short video?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_tool with the task and budget 0, then lists 3 to 5 tools or models with a free option, each with a one-line summary, open or closed, and a link to its plainly.guide page.

positive.description: Full details about one named tool
positive.prompt: Tell me what Midjourney costs and whether I can sell the images.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls get_entry for midjourney and reports its plans and prices, the commercial-use terms and conditions, and the last-checked date, linking https://plainly.guide/tools/midjourney/.

positive.description: Compare two to five named tools
positive.prompt: Compare Suno and Udio for making songs I can sell.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls compare_tools with suno and udio and compares free option, cheapest paid plan, commercial use and licence, with last-checked dates and links.

positive.prompt: Which open-source models can clone my voice for a podcast?
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_tool with open_source true (area voice optional) and returns only open-source or open-weights entries, noting licence limits on commercial use where present.

positive.prompt: I need an AI image generator under $15 a month that lets me use the images commercially.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls find_tool with budget 15, area image and commercial_use true, presents matches with cheapest paid plan and commercial-use conditions, and may call get_entry for detail on one option.

negative.description: Asks the plugin to make the content itself
negative.prompt: Generate a picture of a cat on a skateboard.

negative.description: Asks for something outside creative AI tools
negative.prompt: What's the best spreadsheet software for my small business accounts?

negative.description: Asks for a quality benchmark or ranking Plainly does not make
negative.prompt: Rank every video model by output quality from best to worst.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, take payments or require an account. It is free and read-only.

publication.release_notes: First release: find_tool, get_entry and compare_tools over Plainly Guide's catalogue of 338 creative AI tools, models and hosts.

es-ES.subtitle: Compara herramientas de IA
es-ES.description: Plainly Guide es un catálogo independiente y en lenguaje claro de 338 herramientas, modelos y servicios de IA creativa para imagen, vídeo, voz, música, presentadores virtuales y 3D. Pide una herramienta para una tarea y recibe una lista con lo que hace cada una, la opción gratuita, el plan de pago más barato, si es abierta o cerrada y si puedes vender lo que creas. Cada dato enlaza a la página del fabricante y muestra cuándo se comprobó. Sin registro, sin datos personales y nadie paga por aparecer ni por su posición.

fr-FR.subtitle: Comparez les outils d'IA
fr-FR.description: Plainly Guide est un catalogue indépendant, rédigé simplement, de 338 outils, modèles et services d'IA créative pour l'image, la vidéo, la voix, la musique, les présentateurs virtuels et la 3D. Demandez un outil pour une tâche et obtenez une sélection avec ce que fait chacun, l'option gratuite, l'offre payante la moins chère, s'il est ouvert ou fermé et si vous pouvez vendre ce que vous créez. Chaque information renvoie à la page du fabricant et indique la date de sa dernière vérification. Sans inscription, sans données personnelles, et personne ne paie pour être listé ou classé.
